summary:
The iPad 7th gen (2019) was the first with a 10.2-inch screen. That means more room for note-taking, and more glass to crack when it slips off a car seat on the school run.

Glass-only repair is available, so a cracked screen often doesn't need a whole new display. A battery replacement costs R900, and a faulty Lightning port is repaired with micro-soldering for typically R900 to R1,200, keeping your data in place.

Every repair starts with a free diagnostic at our workshop in Silvercrest Shopping Centre, Silvamonte, uses OEM-spec parts, and carries a 6-month warranty.

Tap Call now to speak to us about your repair.
